strip.hotelsTracked: {count, plural, one {# hotel} other {# hotels}} tracked

city.title: {name} market
city.info: Occupancy is estimated from {coverage, plural, one {# hotel} other {# hotels}} scanned in detail with enough data. Hotels with rooms is the figure Booking.com shows for this night. Average rate and rate distribution use {priced, plural, one {# hotel} other {# hotels}} with rates seen on the results page (a sample).
city.roomsLeftTitle: Total rooms left at hotels scanned in detail with exact counts
city.foundOver: {found} hotels with rooms (per Booking) · {total} hotels on the matched list
city.notScanned: List not scanned for this night yet
city.sampleTitle: Rates from hotels seen on the results page; does not cover the whole area

indicator.title: Market indicator
indicator.info: Estimated competitor occupancy tonight (from rooms left on the reference channel), rooms left at hotels with exact counts and the spread of tonight's lowest rates.

weather.title: Weather
weather.info: 5-day forecast at your hotel (OpenWeather), updated every 30 minutes.

signals.title: Booking signals today
signals.info: Booking counts the channel itself shows on hotel pages (for example “booked 37 times today”), counting only signals seen in the past 24 hours. This is the channel's marketing message, not actual bookings.
signals.empty: The channel has not shown bookings for your tracked hotels in the past 24 hours
signals.summary: bookings today across {hotels, plural, one {# hotel} other {# hotels}}
signals.summary24h: bookings today across {hotels, plural, one {# hotel} other {# hotels}} · {day24} in 24 hours

revenue.title: 14-day revenue
revenue.info: With PMS: revenue on the books per night (rooms sold × ADR when revenue is missing). Without PMS: estimate = your lowest rate × estimated occupancy × rooms seen on the channel, only for nights with a reliable estimate.
revenue.empty: Not enough data to calculate revenue for the next 14 days.
revenue.caption: {source, select, pms {revenue on the books (PMS)} other {projected revenue (estimate)}} · {known}/14 nights with data
revenue.importForActual: Import PMS data for actual figures

calendar.title: Events in the next 12 months
calendar.info: Public holidays for the hotel's country (built-in table) and local events you add in Settings › Events. % is the demand uplift you expect. Click a period to see availability around those dates.
